content:
I'll provide the new bucket resources and updated IAM policies for both environments. I'm assuming the existing service principals are named `myapp-sa` (User, dev) and `myapp-role` (Role, prod), with an S3 access policy already attached — adjust the names if they differ in your actual `iam.yaml`.

The approach is to add a new statement to the existing policies granting `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on the logs bucket only, keeping the assets bucket permissions unchanged.

---

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: User
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa
spec:
  userName: myapp-sa
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-s3-access
spec:
  name: myapp-s3-access
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:ListBucket"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-dev/*"
          ]
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: UserPolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa-s3-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp-sa
  policyARN: <reference-to-policy-arn>
```

---

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/iam.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-role
spec:
  roleName: myapp-role
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B716D3041E:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-s3-access
spec:
  name: myapp-s3-access
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:ListBucket"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-assets-prod/*"
          ]
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-role-s3-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp-role
  policyARN: <reference-to-policy-arn>
```

---

**Notes:**

- Each bucket is independently configured with versioning, AES-256 encryption, and full public access blocking.
- The IAM policies are updated to include two separate statements: one for the existing assets bucket (unchanged) and one new statement for the logs bucket, each scoped narrowly to their respective resources.
- The `policyARN` field in `UserPolicyAttachment` and `RolePolicyAttachment` should reference the actual ARN of the policy; in a real deployment, this is typically resolved via a cross-reference or by the ACK controller using the policy name if it's in the same namespace.
- Service principal names (`myapp-sa`, `myapp-role`) and OIDC identifiers in the assume-role policy should be adjusted to match your actual configuration.
